candidates.description: This vector represents the Devanagari character 'भ' (bha) and its various vowel and consonant combinations along with some encoding noise.
These tokens represent various combinations of the consonant 'k' (क) with different Hindi vowel signs and independent vowels.
This feature vector activates strongly on specific Hindi and Sanskrit character combinations, particularly involving the consonant 'व' (va) and related dependent vowel signs.
This feature vector activates Hindi verbal roots and inflectional suffixes.
These tokens represent characters, vowel signs, and common initial clusters from the Devanagari script used for Hindi and other Indian languages.
This feature vector activates on specific characters, syllables, and subword tokens from the Devanagari script used in Hindi and related languages.
This vector represents Devanagari vowel signs and dependent vowel modifiers attached with punctuation marks.
This vector represents Devanagari vowel signs, matras, and associated punctuation marks.
This vector is related to subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi script text.
This feature vector represents common Hindi verb roots and their inflections.
